answer: Trust-walk payouts: honest agents vouch for peers they actually traded with, forming a graph. Each epoch, run 4 short random walks (log n steps, proposed) from 50 seed agents and pay by landing probability. A sybil farm is an island linked to the honest graph by a few bridge edges, so walks rarely cross in; it is no haven, and clone scores sink toward the nadir however many fakes join. To measure: score ratio of planted test sybils vs honest IDs.
